items.title: Andy Anderson Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: I do some of them now, you know. Some of them try to do something, remind me of him, you know.

ctx.x: I've been asked about him playing across the lake, too. Did you ever do that?

Oh yeah, he was a nice, he was a nice drummer. I'll tell you about Buddy Petit, what I love about Buddy Petit. He couldn't make no high notes like Lou Armstrong, but he did make everything that Lou Armstrong made, see. That's one thing about this song, you know. I love that, you know. And he could play you a beautiful second by head, you know, just by air like that. Makes some pretty parts. I do some of them now, you know. Some of them try to do something, remind me of him, you know. Some of those things you hear…
He played all the other little fast things.
